newsitem.title: UK: British Gas names TransCo exploration head.
newsitem.headline: British Gas names TransCo exploration head.

text.p: British Gas Plc said on Monday it had apppointed Frank Chapman as managing director for exploration and production and executive director (designate) for its TransCo International arm.

TransCo is due to be demerged from the rest of British Gas and will include the gas transportation and storage business, exploration and production, the international downstream businesses, research and technology, propery and "other current corporate functions".
Chapman, 43, spent 18 years with Shell and most recently was president of Kvaerner Oil and Gas UK, during June and July 1996.
